_comment: ZenZork v2 Story 7 (#10569) capability-driven drops -- authored data only, ships empty (Episode content is #10573). Authored content requests a CANONICAL capability name (e.g. inventory, ticket_history, media_search, fabrication, finance, flight_tracking) -- never a raw HA label directly. This file is the one place that maps a canonical name to the actual resolver label, same presence-check mechanism household_systems.json already uses (label_entities(label) | length > 0, real live-tagged entities required, not just label-taxonomy membership). Each entry: name (canonical capability name authored content uses), resolver_label (the actual HA label checked -- the only place this household-specific detail lives), drops (list of {item_name, flavor_dungeon, flavor_zork} -- optional junk, no required Episode 1 path may depend on one being present). mode=capability_drop_action=roll picks randomly from a present capability's drop pool; absent capability = no-op, not an error, since these are always optional. SPOILER CURTAIN (mandatory): each drop's flavor_dungeon/flavor_zork must be base64 at rest -- decoded once at load, same convention as book_lore.json. Plain text in these fields will decode to garbage. name/resolver_label/drops[].item_name stay plain.
